data.body:
[P3] Preserve external type strings inherited by child contexts

`hasExternalErrorType` checks the current operation type, but context checkpoints can contain error types copied from callbacks or invokes. For an external failure named `com.acme.PaymentError/0xdead` inside `runInChildContext`, the callback or invoke reports `PaymentError/0xdead`, while the context and propagated execution report `PaymentError`: the context takes the Java-only suffix-stripping path. The previous implementation preserved the same type throughout. Restrict hidden-class cleanup to types known to originate from Java classes, preserving external provenance through contexts, and add nested callback/invoke coverage.
